remarks: Set against the canyon in the coveted Laurelwood neighborhood, this beautifully renovated five-bedroom, four-bathroom home pairs warm, considered interiors with sweeping views and effortless indoor-outdoor living. Cedar-beamed ceilings and a concrete wood-burning fireplace anchor the main living space, while expansive multi-slide doors open directly to the pool and spa, built-in BBQ and outdoor fireplace, creating a natural extension of the home and an idyllic setting for entertaining against a spectacular canyon backdrop. At the heart of the home, the kitchen takes full advantage of those same views, with a dramatic 10-foot island, custom wine storage and Thermador appliances. Italian oak
